tasks.h: Background, degree, class of award, work history, family situation, timeline.
Every institution attended, with dates and the grading scale used.
Fall is the largest intake and carries the most funding. Spring is smaller and faster.
Taught MS/MA, thesis MS, MBA or MEng — they fund and hire very differently.
What the family can commit per year, and what must come from an assistantship or loan.
Scope, fee, what the client is responsible for, what you are not.
TOEFL iBT, IELTS Academic, Duolingo English Test or PTE Academic — confirm which ones each target school accepts.
Book 6-8 weeks before the first deadline so there is room for a retake.
Check the programme minimum and the separate section minimums, which are often the binding constraint.
Many programmes are now test-optional or have waivers for work experience. Confirm in writing on the programme page.
Only where it is genuinely required or where a strong score offsets a weaker transcript.
Score reports go direct from the testing body. Order them early — delivery is not instant.
Start wide — 20 to 30 programmes — then cut.
Two reach, four match, two safe. A list of only reaches is the most common way a season is lost.
Priority/funding deadlines are usually weeks before the final deadline — the funding one is the real one.
For thesis and PhD-track programmes, two or three named faculty per school changes the SOP completely.
Tuition plus fees, health insurance, and living cost for the city. Get the figures from the school's own cost-of-attendance page.
Sealed, from every institution attended. Allow weeks, not days.
If it has not been issued yet, an attestation or provisional letter from the registrar usually works.
Course-by-course from a NACES member (WES, ECE, SpanTran, Josef Silny) where the school asks for one.
Two pages maximum, no photo, no date of birth, no marital status. Results with numbers.
What they want to study, why that is the natural next step, why this department, what they will do after.

tasks.t: SOP reviewed and tailored per school
tasks.h: One base statement, then a named paragraph per programme. A generic SOP reads as a generic applicant.
Ask by email with a deadline, the CV, the SOP draft and a reminder of specific work they supervised.
Recommenders upload through each portal. Chase at two weeks out, not two days.
Only where the programme asks — design, architecture, creative writing, some research MS.
One login per school. Keep every username and password in one place the client controls.
Review every form once cold, a day later. Name spelling must match the passport exactly.
Some departments waive fees on request for international applicants or for early applications.
Submit against the funding deadline, not the final deadline.
Save every confirmation email and application ID to the client's file.
GA/TA/RA applications are often separate from admission, and separately deadlined.
Update the shortlist status the day each decision arrives.
Sticker tuition means little. Compare tuition minus award, plus fees, insurance and living cost.
Decline the others in writing so the seats and any funding move on.

tasks.t: Financial documents submitted to the school
tasks.h: Bank statement and sponsor affidavit covering at least the first year, in the school's required format.
Check the spelling of the name, date of birth, programme, start date and funding figure against the passport.
Pay at fmjfee.com using the SEVIS ID on the I-20. Print the receipt.
One form per applicant at ceac.state.gov. Keep the confirmation barcode page.
Book as early as the embassy calendar allows — slots, not documents, are usually the bottleneck.
Study plan, choice of school, funding, ties to home. Short, consistent, honest answers.
Carry the I-20, DS-160 confirmation, SEVIS receipt, passport, financials and academic records.
Check the visa page for the correct name, classification and annotation before leaving the counter.
Arrive inside the 30 days before the I-20 start date — entry earlier than that is not permitted.
On-campus grad housing if it exists. Otherwise a short first lease or temporary stay, viewed in person before signing long.
Most schools enrol students in their own plan automatically and require specific immunisation records.

tasks.t: Funds for the first 60 days arranged
tasks.h: Tuition deposit, first rent, deposit, phone, groceries — before any stipend or loan disbursement lands.
Documents in hand luggage, address of first night, campus contact, airport transfer.
A call in week one and week four catches problems while they are still small.
